title: Event subscriptions
subtitle: Track durable custody separately from business results
unavailable: No source is currently available for enablement. Existing custody remains visible and drains.
featureOff: Reception is disabled; accepted custody continues draining.
empty: No subscription is bound. Ordinary manual runs retain the saved input.
name: Name
testPassed: Connection verified; no group join, message custody or business execution.
newRequest: Close and review a new request
retryNote: For an unknown result, retry this request ID with unchanged parameters. Close and reopen to change its meaning.
replayNote: Creates a new Delivery/Execution and preserves the original terminal result. Original input/activation is the default; current configuration requires disabling and no other unfinished custody.
skipNote: Records an unprocessed disposition. Original failures remain failures; an unaccepted source record may never reach business processing.
resetNote: Requires disabled reception, closed listeners and drained custody. A new epoch may reread or skip source history. Old custody/audit remain; target idempotency is required.
disableNote: Fences source ownership and waits for actual closure. Accepted events keep executing; existing Executions are not cancelled.
enableNote: Freezes the saved Revision, Worker and credential references. Source acknowledgment means durable custody only. Save workbench changes first.
deleteNote: Deleting the binding retains historical events, executions and audit. Disable and drain first.
repairNote: Pauses new dispatch and waits for existing executions to settle. Change code/dependencies only; original activation, Worker, credentials and later pending versions remain unchanged.
locked: Subscription reception, stopping, draining or repair locks ordinary code, Worker, input and trigger editing.
boundMode: A subscription is bound: delete it after disabling/draining before changing to scheduled triggers.
readOnly: Read only. Configuration and dispositions require Adapter edit permission.
operationFailed: Operation incomplete. Refresh and review permissions, version and custody.
originalState: Original execution terminal states remain unchanged; the following states belong to each delivery.
gapNote: Control/aborted markers can produce conservative gaps. Do not advance to the client position automatically. UUID metadata checks are not an atomic Fetch fence.
credentialNote: SCRAM reads username/password from Secret Store. Select a reference here; never paste passwords, tokens or private keys.
rangeNote: Only per_event + partition_serial; up to 16 exact topics and 16 accumulated partitions per epoch. Scope/initial-position changes require an explicit new epoch.
newEpoch: Confirm that scope/initial-position changes create a new epoch

errors.source_history_gap: Saved position is outside readable history. Review before explicit reset.
errors.source_checkpoint_ahead: Broker commits lead DLR custody; skipping is forbidden.
errors.source_authentication_failed: Authentication failed. Correct the Secret Store credential before resume.
errors.source_authorization_failed: Insufficient permissions. Review exact topic/group ACLs.
errors.source_tls_failed: TLS verification failed. Review CA and hostname.
errors.subscription_capacity_exceeded: Custody capacity is exhausted; wait for low water or govern history.
errors.source_identity_changed: Source identity changed. Preserve old custody and review a new epoch.
errors.source_close_unconfirmed: Actual closure is unconfirmed; its permit remains occupied.
errors.subscription_binding_conflict: This Adapter already has an incompatible trigger or subscription binding.
errors.subscription_draining: Wait for the required listener closure, custody drain or executions to settle.
errors.subscription_config_conflict: The configuration version changed. Close this dialog, refresh and review a new request.
errors.subscription_owner_stale: Source ownership has been fenced; the old owner cannot accept more data.
errors.event_identity_conflict: The same source identity has different content. Review the source before proceeding.
errors.event_payload_too_large: The complete event exceeds the input limit and was not accepted. Review the source or explicitly skip it.
errors.event_payload_expired: The retained payload expired; this event cannot be replayed.
errors.source_not_available: This source is not available for product enablement.
errors.source_connection_timeout: Connection diagnostics timed out. This alone does not prove an authentication failure. Actual client closure may still be pending.
errors.source_group_conflict: The dedicated consumer group is occupied or conflicts with another subscription.
errors.source_partition_limit: The source epoch exceeded its cumulative partition limit. Review scope and reset explicitly if appropriate.
errors.source_protocol_unsupported: The broker protocol or pinned client integration is unsupported.
errors.source_temporarily_unavailable: The source is temporarily unreachable; bounded backoff retries continue.
errors.source_credential_invalid: The referenced source credential does not provide the required username/password or SCRAM configuration.
errors.subscription_listener_not_closed: Actual listener closure is not confirmed. Keep its permit and wait.
errors.event_execution_active: An execution is still active; wait for its terminal result.
errors.event_replay_in_progress: This event already has an unfinished replay.
errors.event_disposition_conflict: This request ID was already used with different parameters. Preserve the original request or review a new one.
errors.source_epoch_required: Scope or initial-position changes require explicit confirmation of a new epoch.
errors.subscription_config_invalid: The source configuration is invalid. Review the closed field list and quota limits.
errors.source_permission_denied: Source LIST/WATCH permission was denied. Review scoped RBAC.
errors.source_object_invalid: The source object identity does not match the configured scope.
errors.source_list_invalid: The LIST page or collection snapshot is invalid.
errors.source_identity_unverified: This historical source identity cannot be verified; review an explicit new epoch.
errors.subscription_sync_history_capacity: The batch cannot reserve protected history. Review retained custody before a new LIST.
errors.subscription_sync_batch_capacity: The full batch exceeded its object or byte limit; its reconciliation is invalid.
errors.subscription_sync_completion_conflict: Completion responsibility changed, is active, invalidated or closed. Read back an existing request before creating a new one.
errors.subscription_sync_reserve_invalid: The prepaid control reserve is inconsistent. Preserve custody and ask an administrator to inspect quota accounting.
errors.subscription_sync_draining: The previous batch or its accepted responsibility must settle first.
errors.source_trust_invalid: API CA trust is invalid. Review the public CA bundle and server origin.
errors.source_list_snapshot_changed: LIST pagination no longer represents one consistent collection snapshot.
errors.source_response_too_large: The bounded source response limit was exceeded; the incomplete batch cannot authorize cleanup.
errors.source_member_skipped: A LIST member or started control was explicitly skipped; this batch cannot authorize cleanup.

versionComparison: Original activation config v{{original}} → current config v{{current}}
resumeNote: Reconnects the same frozen activation and source epoch, reading current Secret Store values for the saved source credential reference. It does not skip blocked custody or apply workbench edits.
limitsInvalid: Enter a JSON object with positive integer values for known quota fields; the server permits tightening only.
previewNote: Compare the original activation with the saved current configuration, including Worker and credential references. Current replay requires this exact preview; concurrent changes are rejected. Repair replaces code/dependencies only. Credential values are never shown.

kubernetes.originInvalid: Enter an HTTPS origin without credentials, API paths, query or fragment.
kubernetes.allNamespacesNote: All namespaces require matching cluster-wide RBAC and enlarge this managed scope.
kubernetes.stateSync: state_sync · explicitly coalesce eligible pending state
kubernetes.perEventNote: Preserves accepted object changes. Expired source history cannot be recovered from a new LIST.
kubernetes.stateSyncNote: Explicit state synchronization: only pending updates of the same UID with no historical Execution can coalesce. Existing execution inputs, LIST members and delete boundaries remain unchanged.
kubernetes.credentialNote: Select a token credential reference. Tokens stay in Secret Store; do not paste tokens or private keys. A missing reference uses anonymous API access.
kubernetes.rangeNote: Only core/v1 Pods and apps/v1 Deployments. LIST uses one consistent collection snapshot; WATCH resource versions are opaque. Read completeness is separate from target reconciliation.
kubernetes.newEpoch: Explicitly create a new epoch for scope, mode or trust changes
kubernetes.resetNote: A new epoch starts a new complete LIST using this saved scope. Old custody and audit remain. No arbitrary resource-version advance or automatic target cleanup is requested.
kubernetes.confirmReset: Confirm a new full LIST epoch for this saved Kubernetes scope
kubernetes.gapNote: WATCH reconnects from the last durable RV. A 410 records a possible history gap and starts a new full LIST after old responsibility settles; it does not reconstruct expired changes.
kubernetes.testPassed: Bounded LIST/WATCH permission and trust checks completed; no DLR custody or business execution.
kubernetes.testResult: Logical cluster {{cluster}} · {{resource}} · {{namespace}} · scope {{scope}} · trust {{trust}} / LIST {{list}} / WATCH {{watch}}

errors.source_history_gap: The saved WATCH RV is no longer readable. Old responsibility must settle before a new LIST; expired changes cannot be reconstructed.
errors.source_credential_invalid: The source credential reference must provide a valid token field. Correct Secret Store values before reconnecting.
errors.source_authentication_failed: API authentication failed. Review the token credential reference.
errors.source_protocol_unsupported: The API response or pinned client integration is unsupported.

batch.title: Full synchronization batches
batch.separateFacts: Source reading, completion freezing, business execution and responsibility closure are separate facts. This screen alone does not verify target cleanup.
batch.abandonImpact: The target cannot be rolled back. This cancels only the latest pending replay without an Execution, if present, and releases this completion barrier. Other failures still require repair, and accepted WATCH events drain in original order. Reception stays disabled; no new LIST starts automatically.
batch.reasonBytes: The reason must not exceed 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
batch.confirmImpact: I understand that the business result remains unconfirmed and the target cannot be rolled back.
batch.closedReplayNote: Closed or abandoned completion cannot create a new replay. An existing request can only read back its original result; a new reconciliation requires a new complete batch.
batch.memberSkipNote: Skipping a LIST member or sync.started permanently invalidates cleanup eligibility for this batch. It records unprocessed responsibility; it does not mean target reconciliation succeeded.

ux.eventHint: Run the saved processing code when an event arrives.
ux.eventInput: Run input: received event content. Manual test input is saved separately.
ux.saveFirst: Save changes to code, runtime settings and input first
ux.codeFirst: Write and save processing code first
ux.workerFirst: Select and save a runtime worker first
ux.settleFirst: Wait for existing work to finish, or resolve the problem in received events
ux.saveSettingsFirst: Save the runtime settings below before configuring the source.
ux.testPassed: Connection test passed. Only source connectivity was checked; processing code was not run.
ux.help: Configure a source, write and save processing code, select a worker, then start receiving. Stopping reception only stops new events; received events still need processing. Inspect and repair failures in received events.
ux.unbindHint: Before switching modes, stop receiving, settle existing work, then explicitly disconnect the source in advanced settings.
ux.statusUnavailable: Event status could not be loaded. Refresh before relying on event filters.

status.stoppedWithWork: Reception stopped; existing events still need processing
